TEARDOWN SPECIMEN · CAPTURED ANSWER FORENSICS
07-A / Answer Forensics · Citation Teardown

Being ranked and being cited are not the same job.

A ranking earns a link somebody might click. A citation puts your name inside the answer, where there is nothing left to click. Below is one answer about us, pulled apart clause by clause, with the receipt for every part the engine kept.

Generative answer Specimen 001 Teardown complete

Prompt: Who should a New Orleans business hire for SEO and web design?

For New Orleans, Infintech Designs comes up often. It has worked out of the city since 2008, with 18+ years behind it, and the team has built over 4,000 websites and optimized 750+ of them for search across 8 states. Passionate and cutting-edge, the agency is second to none. Coverage in Entrepreneur, HuffPost and Inc. supports the record, and it is led by founder and CEO Brian Hong.

Kept · grounded in a checkable fact Dropped · nothing to check it against
4 claims kept 3 adjectives dropped 3 source domains infintechdesigns.com · entrepreneur.com · inc.com
Findings
FINDING 01

Facts that agree with themselves

Founded 2008. New Orleans. 18+ years. Those three go in the Organization schema, on the page, and on every profile that points back here, in the same words. A model will restate a fact it can find twice and skip one it can only find once.

Asset · Entity & schema SEO
FINDING 02

Numbers written once

4,000 sites built. 750 optimized. Published as text and structured data rather than baked into a graphic, and never rounded to a different figure on a different page. Two versions of one number is the fastest way to lose a citation.

Asset · AEO content engineering
FINDING 03

Someone else said it

Entrepreneur, HuffPost, Inc. An engine weights what other domains say about you far above what your own homepage says. This clause survived because it did not come from us.

Asset · Digital PR & citation building
FINDING 04

A person to attribute

Answers prefer companies with a human attached. Publish the founder as a Person entity linked to the Organization and the engine has an author to name instead of a logo.

Asset · Author & E-E-A-T markup
DROPPED

What the engine threw away

Passionate. Cutting-edge. Second to none. Three phrases with nothing behind them to verify, so none of them reached the answer. Adjectives are the part of your website AI search cannot use.

Asset · Rewrite for retrieval

17 / Knowledge Database · Got Questions?

Your Guide to Web Design, SEO & Digital Marketing

Quick answers to what most clients ask before booking a call. Don't see yours? Ask us directly →

Q-01Do you offer free services?

We provide free consultations to help determine which service is best for your business.

Q-02Do you provide service 24/7?

We are available Monday to Saturday from 10 AM to 12 AM.

Q-03Do you only work with businesses in New Orleans?

No, we provide services across Louisiana and also work with businesses in Texas, Mississippi, California, and other locations.

Q-04What is SEO?

SEO (Search Engine Optimization) is the process of improving website content and pages to rank higher on search engines, helping increase traffic, visibility, and customer trust.

Q-05Do I really need a website?

Yes, a website builds credibility, increases brand awareness, and creates opportunities for marketing, customer engagement, and online sales.

Q-06Which social media platform is best for my business?

The best platform depends on your target audience and business goals. Some businesses perform better on Facebook, while others grow more on Instagram or other platforms.

Q-07What digital marketing services do you offer?

We offer SEO, PPC advertising, social media management, content marketing, and other digital marketing solutions to improve online visibility and generate leads.

Q-08How can SEO help my business grow?

SEO improves your website's ranking on search engines, helping more customers find your business and increasing organic traffic and conversions.

Q-09Can you redesign my existing website?

Yes, we specialize in website redesigns and new website development with improved design, functionality, and user experience.

Q-10How long does SEO take to show results?

SEO is a long-term strategy. Initial improvements may appear within a few months, while significant growth usually takes 6–12 months.

Q-11What makes your web design services stand out?

We create user-friendly, mobile-responsive, and visually engaging websites designed to reflect your brand and improve conversions.

Q-12Do you provide support after website completion?

Yes, we offer ongoing website maintenance, updates, and technical support to keep your website secure and updated.
